# Hi There!
Welcome. This site is where I share my work, ideas, and interests. Thanks for stopping by. All opinions are my own.

# Who I am:
I enjoy learning, using data to answer interesting questions, and spending time with my family, friends, and dogs. I live in Richmond, VA.

# What I do:
I'm currently a Principal Data Scientist at Gallup where I get to answer complex questions with world data, use advanced statistics, and help build meaningful partnerships across DOD, other government agencies, and the public sector.
